'''Greg Heisler Bring Him Before Me is MONEY''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Greg Heisler]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-8959">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8959 Bring Him Before Me is MONEY], DeckTech (Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler, 1 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/8959/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/8959/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022111724/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8959/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Greg Heisler]]
* '''Published:''' 1 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Bring Him Before Me is MONEY''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 BHBM Heisler DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck revolves around the new Mobilization Points effect and Sienar Fleet Systems.  The deck is currently undefeated.

== Original post ==

'''Bring Him Before Me is MONEY'''
* '''Author:''' Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler
* '''Published:''' August 1, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This deck revolves around the new Mobilization Points effect and Sienar Fleet Systems.  The deck is currently undefeated.

=== Strategy ===

Ok, this deck suprises the hell out of people.  Tie Defenders?  Whooo  Power 5 w/ All power to Weapons is Money  Hyperspeed and destiny 3.  Tie Scouts were first, but Defenders are just so much more powerful.

The Dark Manuevers are for getting your manuever higher so that you are not power -2.

You dominate in space.	You can get drains up to like 8 or 9 easy.  Vader on the ground with a saber is a wall.  If you need to you can go grab Luke and duel is monkey-butt, and school him.  Win battles in space and ground and insignificant rebellion will make make dueling him and winning possible.  Also, you can add a Tatooine docking bay if you are worried about Profit.	Alter is not worth playing just for Honor, because good players will occupy first anyways.

The game winner can be Imperial Decree.  If you rule space, then make Vader your boogie man on the ground and cancel his bonuses

Enjoy
